note: AFG Bank Cameroun's general banking conditions (in force from 1 January 2026): keeping the account is among the services of the guaranteed minimum banking service, free (franco), and the account-keeping fee is nothing for private customers who aren't traders, as a performer isn't; statements on request and card charges aren't modelled.
